description: Validates an explicitly approved operator-provided licensed USPS City State package through a protected local managed operation. Approval registries are empty by default; no network, current pointer, production admission, or redistribution is authorized.
retry: No automatic retry; correct the rejected local input or declaration and invoke again.
checkpoint: No checkpoint; validation completes before immutable manifest publication.
idempotency: Source month and SHA-256 determine the immutable admission identity; an existing identity is never overwritten.
cancellation: Copy, validation, replay, staging, and downstream candidate construction honor cooperative cancellation. Staging is removed before publication; an already atomically published immutable package remains inspectable and is never presented as production admission.
retention_profile: Operation-owned bounded copies and admitted projections remain local-restricted; no licensed rows are redistributed
